Four test files call `findEnclosingSgSymbols` directly. Each one imports it from `../src/sg.js`:

- `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

The function is also called inside the sg tool itself (`src/sg.ts:415`), but only when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1` is set and the number of matched files is under a set limit. The only test that sets that variable and also runs the sg tool is `context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`, which is already in the list. `context-hygiene-debug-tool.test.ts` sets the same variable but never calls sg.

<answer>
tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts
tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts
tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts
tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts
